sony_high_iso_normalization.scope: signed sensor normalization and diagnostic-only zero clipping; not a production clipping policy

interpretation: The matched-crop high-ISO signed result differs materially from the oracle. Diagnostic sensor zero clipping accounts for much of the red/green mean difference but leaves an 8.6% blue mean difference. It does not prove an exact clipping stage in the oracle or establish calibration equality. Production signed-value handling was not changed.
